ffmpeg 基本上可以算是 影音處理領域的 must-have CLI tool。
如果你的日常有任何影片、音訊、截圖、錄影、直播、轉檔、壓縮、批次處理，它幾乎是底層標準工具。

很多 GUI 工具、剪片軟體、轉檔器、錄影工具、字幕工具，其實底層也是在調 ffmpeg。

ffmpeg 可以做什麼？

1. 影片格式轉換

例如把 .mov 轉成 .mp4：

ffmpeg -i input.mov output.mp4

指定編碼：

ffmpeg -i input.mov -c:v libx264 -c:a aac output.mp4

常見用途：

mov -> mp4
mkv -> mp4
webm -> mp4
avi -> mp4
flv -> mp4

⸻

2. 影片壓縮

把影片壓小，適合傳訊息、上傳、備份：

ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 28 -preset slow -c:a aac -b:a 128k output.mp4

大概可以理解：

-crf 越小畫質越好、檔案越大
-crf 18 很高畫質
-crf 23 預設附近
-crf 28 比較小
-crf 32 更小但畫質明顯下降

⸻

3. 抽取音訊

從影片取出 mp3：

ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -vn -c:a libmp3lame output.mp3

取出原本音訊，不重新編碼：

ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -vn -c:a copy output.m4a

⸻

4. 音訊格式轉換

ffmpeg -i input.wav output.mp3
ffmpeg -i input.flac output.m4a
ffmpeg -i input.m4a output.wav

例如把錄音轉成 Whisper / ASR 常用格式：

ffmpeg -i input.m4a -ar 16000 -ac 1 output.wav

這個在做語音辨識、AI transcription 很常用。

⸻

5. 裁切影片片段

從第 30 秒開始，截 10 秒：

ffmpeg -ss 00:00:30 -i input.mp4 -t 10 -c copy clip.mp4

更精準但會重新編碼：

ffmpeg -ss 00:00:30 -i input.mp4 -t 10 clip.mp4

⸻

6. 合併影片

先建立 files.txt：

file 'part1.mp4'
file 'part2.mp4'
file 'part3.mp4'

然後：

ffmpeg -f concat -safe 0 -i files.txt -c copy output.mp4

這很適合合併錄影、課程分段、遊戲錄影片段。

⸻

7. 影片轉 GIF

ffmpeg -i input.mp4 output.gif

比較好的方式通常會加 fps 和尺寸：

ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -vf "fps=12,scale=640:-1" output.gif

⸻

8. 抽影片截圖

取某一秒的畫面：

ffmpeg -ss 00:01:23 -i input.mp4 -frames:v 1 screenshot.png

每秒截一張：

ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -vf fps=1 frame_%04d.png

⸻

9. 圖片序列轉影片

ffmpeg -framerate 30 -i frame_%04d.png -c:v libx264 output.mp4

這在視覺化、ML、動畫、資料分析裡很常見。

⸻

10. 加字幕

軟字幕封裝進 mp4/mkv：

ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -i subtitle.srt -c copy output.mkv

燒錄字幕到畫面上：

ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -vf subtitles=subtitle.srt output.mp4

⸻

11. 調整解析度、fps、旋轉

改解析度：

ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -vf scale=1280:-1 output.mp4

改 fps：

ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -r 30 output.mp4

旋轉：

ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -vf "transpose=1" output.mp4

⸻

12. 螢幕錄影 / 攝影機錄影 / 串流

Linux 上可以錄螢幕：

ffmpeg -f x11grab -i :0.0 output.mp4

macOS 可以用 avfoundation：

ffmpeg -f avfoundation -list_devices true -i ""

直播推流到 RTMP：

ffmpeg -re -i input.mp4 -c copy -f flv rtmp://server/live/key

這也是 OBS、直播、轉播流程常見的底層工具。

⸻

常搭配的工具

ffmpeg 生態常見還有幾個 CLI：

ffprobe

查看媒體資訊：

ffprobe input.mp4

更結構化：

ffprobe -v error -show_format -show_streams input.mp4
ffplay

簡單播放影片/音訊：

ffplay input.mp4

⸻

是否是 must-have？

我會說：

對一般人

不是每天用，但裝了很值得。
很多時候你只要遇到一次「影片太大傳不上去」、「格式不支援」、「想抽音訊」、「想裁一段」，ffmpeg 就非常有用。

對開發者 / power user

幾乎是 must-have。

尤其是你這種常搞 CLI、AI tooling、資料處理、錄音轉文字、影片截圖、terminal workflow 的情境，ffmpeg 很值得常備。

對做 ML / CV / Audio / ASR 的人

絕對 must-have。

例如：

影片 dataset 前處理
抽 frame
統一 fps
轉 wav 16kHz mono
壓縮 demo video
生成可視化影片
處理錄音檔

⸻

安裝方式

Ubuntu：

sudo apt update
sudo apt install ffmpeg

macOS：

brew install ffmpeg

Windows：

winget install Gyan.FFmpeg

或用 Chocolatey：

choco install ffmpeg

⸻

我會怎麼定位它？

可以把 ffmpeg 理解成：

影音世界的 ImageMagick + jq + rsync

也就是：

不是最漂亮
不是最好記
但超級強、超級通用、幾乎所有人都間接依賴它

它的缺點是參數很多、語法有點難記。
但常用場景其實就那幾組 command，存成 shell function / alias / script 之後就很舒服。

例如我會建議常備幾個 alias/function：

# 壓縮影片
compress-video() {
  ffmpeg -i "$1" -c:v libx264 -crf 28 -preset slow -c:a aac -b:a 128k "${1%.*}_compressed.mp4"
}
# 抽音訊
extract-audio() {
  ffmpeg -i "$1" -vn -c:a copy "${1%.*}.m4a"
}
# 轉成 16k mono wav，給 ASR/Whisper 用
to-wav16k() {
  ffmpeg -i "$1" -ar 16000 -ac 1 "${1%.*}_16k.wav"
}

總結一句：ffmpeg 是影音處理的底層瑞士刀，對 CLI 使用者非常值得裝。

圖片處理相關的話，ffmpeg 也能做，但它不是最適合的主力圖片工具。

我會這樣分工：

單張圖片 / 批次圖片處理：ImageMagick / GraphicsMagick / vips
影片、動圖、圖片序列、抽 frame：ffmpeg
圖片 metadata：exiftool / identify / file
AI / CV pipeline：Python + Pillow / OpenCV / torchvision

ffmpeg 在圖片處理上的常見用途

1. 影片抽 frame

每秒抽一張：

ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -vf fps=1 frame_%04d.png

每 10 秒抽一張：

ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -vf fps=1/10 frame_%04d.jpg

抽指定時間點截圖：

ffmpeg -ss 00:01:23 -i input.mp4 -frames:v 1 screenshot.png

這是 ffmpeg 在圖片處理裡最常見、最有價值的用途之一。

⸻

2. 圖片序列轉影片

ffmpeg -framerate 30 -i frame_%04d.png -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p output.mp4

這在資料視覺化、ML 訓練結果、動畫、回測 replay、OpenCV pipeline 裡很常用。

例如你的資料是：

frame_0001.png
frame_0002.png
frame_0003.png
...

就可以直接變成影片。

⸻

3. 圖片轉 GIF / GIF 轉影片

影片轉 GIF：

ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -vf "fps=12,scale=640:-1" output.gif

GIF 轉 MP4：

ffmpeg -i input.gif -movflags faststart -pix_fmt yuv420p output.mp4

實務上 GIF 很肥，很多時候轉成 MP4/WebM 更合理。

⸻

4. 批次轉圖片格式

例如 PNG 轉 JPG：

ffmpeg -i input.png output.jpg

WebP 轉 PNG：

ffmpeg -i input.webp output.png

單張可以這樣做，但批次大量圖片時，我通常更推薦 ImageMagick 或 vips。

⸻

5. resize / crop / rotate

縮放圖片：

ffmpeg -i input.png -vf scale=1280:-1 output.png

裁切：

ffmpeg -i input.png -vf "crop=800:600:100:50" output.png

意思是：

crop=寬:高:x起點:y起點

旋轉 90 度：

ffmpeg -i input.png -vf transpose=1 output.png

⸻

6. 圖片加水印 / 疊圖

把 logo 疊到右下角：

ffmpeg -i input.png -i logo.png -filter_complex "overlay=W-w-20:H-h-20" output.png

如果是影片加圖片水印，ffmpeg 更常用：

ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -i logo.png -filter_complex "overlay=W-w-20:H-h-20" output.mp4

⸻

7. 從圖片生成縮圖

ffmpeg -i input.png -vf scale=320:-1 thumbnail.jpg

也可以從影片生成縮圖：

ffmpeg -ss 00:00:05 -i input.mp4 -frames:v 1 -vf scale=320:-1 thumbnail.jpg

⸻

但圖片主力 CLI 我更推薦 ImageMagick

安裝：

sudo apt install imagemagick

macOS：

brew install imagemagick

新版主要命令是 magick。

查看圖片資訊

magick identify input.png

更詳細：

magick identify -verbose input.png

resize

magick input.png -resize 1280x output.png

限制最大寬高：

magick input.png -resize 1280x1280 output.png

批次 resize

mkdir -p resized
for f in *.jpg; do
  magick "$f" -resize 1280x "resized/$f"
done

壓縮 JPG

magick input.jpg -quality 85 output.jpg

PNG 轉 JPG

magick input.png -background white -alpha remove output.jpg

裁切

magick input.png -crop 800x600+100+50 output.png

圓角、加邊框、合成圖

ImageMagick 在這類「圖片加工」上比 ffmpeg 順手很多。

⸻

大量圖片處理：vips 很強

如果你處理大量高解析圖片，例如幾千張、幾萬張，vips 通常比 ImageMagick 更快、更省記憶體。

安裝：

sudo apt install libvips-tools

macOS：

brew install vips

resize：

vips resize input.jpg output.jpg 0.5

產生縮圖：

vipsthumbnail input.jpg -s 1280 -o output.jpg

批量圖片處理、server-side thumbnail pipeline，vips 很值得知道。

⸻

metadata / EXIF：exiftool

如果你要看圖片拍攝時間、相機、GPS、方向資訊：

exiftool image.jpg

移除 metadata：

exiftool -all= image.jpg

保留原檔會產生 image.jpg_original，可以加：

exiftool -all= -overwrite_original image.jpg

這對分享圖片、去除隱私資訊很有用。

⸻

Pillow / OpenCV 則是 Python 裡的主力

Pillow 適合

開圖
resize
crop
轉格式
加文字
簡單 filter
做 dataset preprocessing

OpenCV 適合

影像辨識
frame processing
camera stream
CV algorithm
色彩空間轉換
邊緣偵測
人臉/物件處理

例如簡單 resize：

from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
def resize_image(input_path: Path, output_path: Path, width: int) -> None:
    with Image.open(input_path) as img:
        ratio = width / img.width
        height = int(img.height * ratio)
        resized = img.resize((width, height))
        resized.save(output_path)
resize_image(Path("input.jpg"), Path("output.jpg"), width=1280)

⸻

我的建議安裝組合

對一般 CLI / dev workflow，我會裝：

sudo apt install ffmpeg imagemagick exiftool

如果你有大量圖片處理需求，再加：

sudo apt install libvips-tools

macOS：

brew install ffmpeg imagemagick exiftool vips

⸻

實際怎麼選？

ffmpeg

用在：

影片抽圖
圖片序列轉影片
GIF / WebM / MP4 互轉
從影片做縮圖
影片加水印

ImageMagick

用在：

單張圖片轉檔
批量 resize
crop
壓縮
加邊框
合成
圖片基本檢查

vips

用在：

大量高解析圖片
server-side thumbnail
需要速度和低記憶體

exiftool

用在：

看 metadata
移除 EXIF
修正拍攝時間
查 GPS

Python Pillow / OpenCV

用在：

可重複 pipeline
dataset preprocessing
CV / ML / AI workflow
需要寫邏輯

所以可以簡單記：

ffmpeg = 影片與 frame
ImageMagick = 圖片瑞士刀
vips = 高效大量圖片處理
exiftool = metadata
Pillow/OpenCV = Python pipeline

對你這種 CLI + ML + 資料處理 workflow，ffmpeg + ImageMagick + exiftool 幾乎可以算圖片/影音基本三件套。
```

43	            "Types: deb" \
44	            "URIs: ${MIRROR_URL}" \

46	            "Components: main restricted universe multiverse" \

10	"""
11	dotfiles_init.py — Interactive wrapper around `chezmoi init` inspired by
12	Vercel Labs' `skills` CLI (https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills).
13	
14	The existing `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl` defines ~19 prompts (profile, email, name,
15	16 feature flags). `chezmoi init` asks them sequentially, which works but
16	hides the feature flags from each other and makes "set up a new machine
17	the way I always do" a manual checklist. This wrapper:
18	
19	  1. Pre-flights chezmoi / git / SSH key and offers to fix gaps.
20	  2. Lets you pick a pre-configured BUNDLE (personal-mac, work-mac,
21	     server-linux, minimal) that ticks typical feature flags for you.
22	  3. Presents feature flags grouped, as a questionary multi-select you can
23	     fly through with Space + Enter.
24	  4. Shells out to `chezmoi init <repo> --apply [--ssh] --promptString ... `
25	     so chezmoi remains the source of truth — we just pre-answer its prompts.
26	  5. Streams chezmoi's output live and prints a recap at the end.
27	
28	The wrapper also has a `doctor` subcommand that greps `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl`
29	and `Dockerfile` and fails loudly if any prompt key in those files is
30	missing from this script's PROMPTS list (or vice versa). Run it in CI / a
31	pre-commit hook to catch drift — per CLAUDE.md's "Dockerfile" cross-file
32	rule, adding a chezmoi prompt means updating three files in one commit.
33	
34	Invocation:
35	    # Fresh machine (via bootstrap.sh which installs uv first):
36	    curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles/main/bootstrap.sh | bash
37	
38	    # Existing chezmoi source dir — re-apply with new answers:
39	    uv run --script ~/.local/share/chezmoi/scripts/init/dotfiles_init.py
40	
41	    # Schema parity check:
42	    uv run --script ~/.local/share/chezmoi/scripts/init/dotfiles_init.py doctor
43	"""

296	@dataclass
297	class Preflight:
298	    chezmoi: str | None
299	    git: str | None
300	    ssh_hint: str | None                # how we detected SSH is ready (or None)
301	    source_exists: bool
302	    os_name: str
303	    is_tty: bool
304	
305	
306	def _detect_ssh() -> str | None:
307	    """Return a short hint describing why we think SSH-to-github is configured,
308	    or None if we can't tell. We accept several signals because the user may
309	    keep keys under non-canonical names and route them via ~/.ssh/config or
310	    its Include'd fragments."""
311	    # (1) Canonical default keys.
312	    for k in SSH_DEFAULT_KEYS:
313	        if k.exists():
314	            return f"default key at {k}"
315	    # (2) ~/.ssh/config (or an Include'd file under ~/.ssh/config.d/) with a
316	    # `Host github…` stanza → user is routing a custom key.
317	    config_texts: list[str] = []
318	    for root in (SSH_CONFIG, *((SSH_DIR / "config.d").glob("*") if (SSH_DIR / "config.d").is_dir() else ())):
319	        if root.is_file():
320	            try:
321	                config_texts.append(root.read_text(errors="replace"))
322	            except OSError:
323	                pass
324	    joined = "\n".join(config_texts)
325	    if re.search(r"(?mi)^\s*Host\s+[\w.\-\* ]*github", joined):
326	        return "~/.ssh/config routes github.com"
327	    # (3) Any loaded key in the agent (default or via IdentityAgent socket).
328	    try:
329	        r = subprocess.run(["ssh-add", "-l"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=3)
330	        if r.returncode == 0 and r.stdout.strip():
331	            return "ssh-agent has keys loaded"
332	    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
333	        pass
334	    return None
335	
336	
337	def detect() -> Preflight:
338	    import platform
339	    return Preflight(
340	        chezmoi=shutil.which("chezmoi"),
341	        git=shutil.which("git"),
342	        ssh_hint=_detect_ssh(),
343	        source_exists=(CHEZMOI_SOURCE_DIR / ".git").is_dir(),
344	        os_name={"Darwin": "darwin", "Linux": "linux"}.get(platform.system(), platform.system().lower()),
345	        is_tty=sys.stdin.isatty() and sys.stdout.isatty(),
346	    )

352	    t.add_row("chezmoi", "✓ " + pf.chezmoi if pf.chezmoi else "✗ [red]not found[/red]")
353	    t.add_row("git", "✓ " + pf.git if pf.git else "✗ [red]not found[/red]")
354	    t.add_row("SSH", f"✓ {pf.ssh_hint}" if pf.ssh_hint else "✗ [yellow]no signal found[/yellow]")
355	    t.add_row("chezmoi source", "✓ present (re-init mode)" if pf.source_exists else "– fresh init")
356	    console.print(t)

360	def install_chezmoi_interactive(os_name: str) -> str:
361	    """Offer to install chezmoi via the canonical one-liner; return new path."""
362	    if not questionary.confirm("chezmoi not found. Install via get.chezmoi.io/lb?", default=True).ask():
363	        console.print("[red]chezmoi is required; aborting.[/red]")
364	        sys.exit(1)
365	    target = Path.home() / ".local" / "bin"
366	    target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
367	    subprocess.check_call(
368	        "curl -fsLS --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 get.chezmoi.io/lb | sh",
369	        shell=True,
370	        env={**os.environ, "BINDIR": str(target)},
371	    )
372	    path = shutil.which("chezmoi") or str(target / "chezmoi")
373	    console.print(f"[green]chezmoi installed at {path}[/green]\n")
374	    return path

377	def ensure_ssh_key_interactive() -> Path | None:
378	    """Offer to generate an ed25519 key; return path or None if user declined."""
379	    if not questionary.confirm(
380	        "No SSH key found. Generate ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 for GitHub (SSH clone)?",
381	        default=True,
382	    ).ask():
383	        return None
384	    key_path = Path.home() / ".ssh" / "id_ed25519"
385	    key_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
386	    email = questionary.text(
387	        "Email to tag the SSH key with:",
388	        default="daviddwlee84@gmail.com",
389	    ).ask() or "daviddwlee84@gmail.com"
390	    subprocess.check_call(["ssh-keygen", "-t", "ed25519", "-C", email, "-f", str(key_path), "-N", ""])
391	    pub = key_path.with_suffix(".pub").read_text().strip()
392	    console.print(Panel(
393	        f"[bold]Add this public key to GitHub → Settings → SSH keys:[/bold]\n\n{pub}\n\n"
394	        f"Open: https://github.com/settings/ssh/new",
395	        title="SSH key generated",
396	        border_style="green",
397	    ))
398	    questionary.press_any_key_to_continue("Press any key once you've added the key to GitHub...").ask()
399	    return key_path

427	def ask_basics(pf: Preflight, overrides: dict[str, object]) -> dict[str, object]:
428	    # profile: auto-detect on Darwin; ask ubuntu_desktop vs ubuntu_server on Linux
429	    default_profile = "macos" if pf.os_name == "darwin" else "ubuntu_server"
430	    if pf.os_name == "darwin":
431	        profile = "macos"
432	        console.print(f"[dim]profile → {profile} (auto-detected)[/dim]")
433	    else:
434	        profile = questionary.select(
435	            "Which profile?",
436	            choices=["ubuntu_server", "ubuntu_desktop"],
437	            default=overrides.get("profile", default_profile),
438	        ).ask() or default_profile
439	
440	    name = questionary.text(
441	        "Your full name:",
442	        default=str(overrides.get("name", _default_for("name"))),
443	    ).ask() or _default_for("name")
444	
445	    email = questionary.text(
446	        "Your git email:",
447	        default=str(overrides.get("email", _default_for("email"))),
448	    ).ask() or _default_for("email")
449	
450	    return {"profile": profile, "name": name, "email": email}

453	def resolve_basics_non_interactive(
454	    pf: Preflight,
455	    overrides: dict[str, object],
456	    *,
457	    name_flag: str | None,
458	    email_flag: str | None,
459	    profile_flag: str | None,
460	) -> dict[str, object]:
461	    """Non-interactive basics: flag → bundle override → embedded default → OS auto-detect."""
462	    if profile_flag:
463	        profile = profile_flag
464	    elif "profile" in overrides:
465	        profile = overrides["profile"]
466	    else:
467	        profile = "macos" if pf.os_name == "darwin" else "ubuntu_server"
468	    name = name_flag or overrides.get("name") or _default_for("name")
469	    email = email_flag or overrides.get("email") or _default_for("email")
470	    return {"profile": profile, "name": name, "email": email}

473	def resolve_features_non_interactive(pf: Preflight, overrides: dict[str, object]) -> dict[str, bool]:
474	    """Non-interactive features: bundle override → embedded default, skipping darwin-only on Linux."""
475	    result: dict[str, bool] = {}
476	    for p in PROMPTS:
477	        if p.kind != "bool" or p.hidden:
478	            continue
479	        if p.darwin_only and pf.os_name != "darwin":
480	            continue
481	        result[p.key] = bool(overrides.get(p.key, p.default))
482	    return result
483	
484	
485	def ask_features(pf: Preflight, overrides: dict[str, object]) -> dict[str, bool]:
486	    """Grouped multi-select. Returns {key: bool} for every non-basics bool prompt."""
487	    feature_prompts = [p for p in PROMPTS if p.kind == "bool" and not p.hidden
488	                       and (pf.os_name == "darwin" or not p.darwin_only)]
489	
490	    groups: dict[str, list[Prompt]] = {}
491	    for p in feature_prompts:
492	        groups.setdefault(p.group, []).append(p)
493	
494	    # Build one flat checkbox preserving group order, with group headers as
495	    # disabled separator rows (purely visual).
496	    choices: list[questionary.Choice] = []
497	    for group, prompts in groups.items():
498	        choices.append(questionary.Separator(f"── {group} ──"))
499	        for p in prompts:
500	            initial = overrides.get(p.key, p.default)
501	            choices.append(questionary.Choice(
502	                title=f"{p.label}  — {p.desc}",
503	                value=p.key,
504	                checked=bool(initial),
505	            ))
506	
507	    console.print()
508	    console.print("[bold]Feature flags[/bold] — Space to toggle, ↑/↓ to move, Enter to confirm.")
509	    selected_keys = questionary.checkbox(
510	        "Which features?",
511	        choices=choices,
512	    ).ask() or []
513	
514	    result: dict[str, bool] = {}
515	    for p in feature_prompts:
516	        result[p.key] = p.key in selected_keys
517	    return result
518

520	def confirm_plan(answers: dict[str, object], argv: list[str]) -> bool:
521	    t = Table(title="Answers", show_header=False, box=None, padding=(0, 2))
522	    t.add_column("Key", style="cyan"); t.add_column("Value")
523	    for p in PROMPTS:
524	        if p.darwin_only and p.key not in answers:
525	            continue
526	        val = answers.get(p.key)
527	        style = "green" if val is True else ("dim" if val is False else "")
528	        t.add_row(p.key, f"[{style}]{val}[/{style}]" if style else str(val))
529	    console.print(t)
530	    console.print()
531	    console.print(Panel(
532	        " ".join(argv),
533	        title="Command about to run",
534	        border_style="blue",
535	    ))
536	    return questionary.confirm("Proceed?", default=True).ask() or False

539	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
540	# Runner
541	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
542	
543	def build_chezmoi_argv(
544	    answers: dict[str, object],
545	    *,
546	    chezmoi_bin: str,
547	    repo: str | None,
548	    use_ssh: bool,
549	    apply: bool,
550	    darwin: bool,
551	) -> list[str]:
552	    """Build the chezmoi init argv. The critical detail is that `chezmoi init`
553	    matches --promptBool / --promptString / --promptChoice flags by the PROMPT
554	    TEXT (3rd arg to promptXOnce in the template), NOT the key name. That's
555	    why every Prompt carries a prompt_text field and we use it here as the
556	    flag key."""
557	    argv: list[str] = [chezmoi_bin, "init"]
558	    if repo:
559	        argv.append(repo)
560	    if use_ssh:
561	        argv.append("--ssh")
562	    if apply:
563	        argv.append("--apply")
564	    by_key = {p.key: p for p in PROMPTS}
565	    # String + choice prompts (basics).
566	    for key in ("email", "name"):
567	        if key in answers:
568	            argv += ["--promptString", f"{by_key[key].prompt_text}={answers[key]}"]
569	    if "profile" in answers:
570	        argv += ["--promptChoice", f"{by_key['profile'].prompt_text}={answers['profile']}"]
571	    # Non-basics choice prompts (e.g. discordChannel).
572	    for p in PROMPTS:
573	        if p.kind != "choice" or p.hidden:
574	            continue
575	        if p.darwin_only and not darwin:
576	            continue
577	        if p.key not in answers:
578	            continue
579	        argv += ["--promptChoice", f"{p.prompt_text}={answers[p.key]}"]
580	    # Bool prompts — skip darwin-only on linux (chezmoi never evaluates them there).
581	    for p in PROMPTS:
582	        if p.kind != "bool" or p.hidden:
583	            continue
584	        if p.darwin_only and not darwin:
585	            continue
586	        if p.key not in answers:
587	            continue
588	        val_str = "true" if answers[p.key] else "false"
589	        argv += ["--promptBool", f"{p.prompt_text}={val_str}"]
590	    return argv
591	
592	
593	def run_chezmoi(argv: list[str]) -> int:
594	    console.print(f"[dim]$ {' '.join(argv)}[/dim]")
595	    console.rule("[bold]chezmoi output[/bold]")
596	    rc = subprocess.call(argv)
597	    console.rule()
598	    return rc
599

601	def print_recap(answers: dict[str, object], rc: int) -> None:
602	    enabled = [p.label for p in PROMPTS if p.kind == "bool" and not p.hidden and answers.get(p.key)]
603	    panel_body = (
604	        f"{'✓' if rc == 0 else '✗'} chezmoi init exit={rc}\n"
605	        f"✓ {len(enabled)} of {sum(1 for p in PROMPTS if p.kind == 'bool' and not p.hidden)} feature groups enabled\n"
606	        f"\nEnabled:\n  " + ("\n  ".join(enabled) if enabled else "(none)")
607	        + "\n\nNext:\n  • Review with: chezmoi diff\n"
608	          "  • Upgrade later with: just upgrade-all\n"
609	          "  • Fleet-apply to other hosts with: just fleet-apply"
610	    )
611	    console.print(Panel(
612	        panel_body,
613	        title="Summary",
614	        border_style="green" if rc == 0 else "red",
615	    ))

618	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
619	# Doctor: schema parity check
620	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
621	
622	def doctor_scan(source_dir: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, str], set[str], dict[str, str]]:
623	    """Return (tmpl: {key: prompt_text}, dockerfile_keys, script: {key: prompt_text})."""
624	    tmpl = (source_dir / ".chezmoi.toml.tmpl").read_text()
625	    tmpl_pairs: dict[str, str] = {}
626	    for k, txt in re.findall(
627	        r'prompt(?:String|Bool|Choice)Once\s+\.\s+"(\w+)"\s+"([^"]+)"', tmpl):
628	        tmpl_pairs[k] = txt
629	
630	    dockerfile = (source_dir / "Dockerfile").read_text()
631	    def _arg_to_camel(s: str) -> str:
632	        parts = s.lower().split("_")
633	        return parts[0] + "".join(p.title() for p in parts[1:])
634	    docker_args = re.findall(r"ARG\s+CHEZMOI_(\w+)\s*=", dockerfile)
635	    docker_keys = {_arg_to_camel(a) for a in docker_args if a.lower() != "repo"}
636	
637	    script_pairs = {p.key: p.prompt_text for p in PROMPTS}
638	    return tmpl_pairs, docker_keys, script_pairs
639	
640	
641	def doctor_report(source_dir: Path) -> int:
642	    tmpl, docker, script = doctor_scan(source_dir)
643	    all_keys = set(tmpl) | docker | set(script)
644	
645	    rows = []
646	    drift = False
647	    for k in sorted(all_keys):
648	        in_t = "✓" if k in tmpl else "[red]✗[/red]"
649	        in_d = "✓" if k in docker else "[yellow]✗[/yellow]"
650	        in_s = "✓" if k in script else "[red]✗[/red]"
651	        if not (k in tmpl and k in docker and k in script):
652	            drift = True
653	        text_note = ""
654	        # Prompt-text mismatches are critical — chezmoi init matches on the text.
655	        if k in tmpl and k in script and tmpl[k] != script[k]:
656	            drift = True
657	            text_note = f"[red]text mismatch[/red]"
658	        rows.append((k, in_t, in_d, in_s, text_note))
659	
660	    t = Table(title="Prompt schema parity")
661	    t.add_column("key"); t.add_column(".chezmoi.toml.tmpl")
662	    t.add_column("Dockerfile"); t.add_column("dotfiles_init.py")
663	    t.add_column("notes")
664	    for row in rows:
665	        t.add_row(*row)
666	    console.print(t)
667	
668	    if drift:
669	        console.print("[red]Drift detected — update the missing files so all three agree.[/red]")
670	        console.print("[dim]Prompt-text mismatches are especially important — chezmoi init\n"
671	                      "matches --promptBool flags by the full prompt text, not the key.[/dim]")
672	        return 1
673	    console.print("[green]All three surfaces agree (keys + prompt texts).[/green]")
674	    return 0
675

681	def _default_for(key: str) -> object:
682	    for p in PROMPTS:
683	        if p.key == key:
684	            return p.default
685	    raise KeyError(key)

688	@dataclass
689	class InitCmd:
690	    """Interactive wrapper around `chezmoi init`.
691	
692	    With --yes (and optionally --bundle / --name / --email / --profile) the
693	    flow becomes fully non-interactive: no TTY required, no prompts shown.
694	    Suitable for Docker / CI. Missing basics fall back to bundle overrides,
695	    then embedded defaults, then OS auto-detection for profile."""
696	
697	    repo: Annotated[str, tyro.conf.arg(help="Chezmoi repo arg (omit on re-init)")] = DEFAULT_REPO
698	    bundle: Annotated[str | None, tyro.conf.arg(help="Skip the picker; use this bundle")] = None
699	    name: Annotated[str | None, tyro.conf.arg(help="Git full name (non-interactive override)")] = None
700	    email: Annotated[str | None, tyro.conf.arg(help="Git email (non-interactive override)")] = None
701	    profile: Annotated[str | None, tyro.conf.arg(help="Profile: macos|ubuntu_desktop|ubuntu_server (auto-detected if omitted)")] = None
702	    ssh: Annotated[bool, tyro.conf.arg(help="Force --ssh even if no key is present")] = False
703	    yes: Annotated[bool, tyro.conf.arg(help="Fully non-interactive: no prompts, no confirmation, assume defaults")] = False
704	    dry_run: Annotated[bool, tyro.conf.arg(help="Print the chezmoi command instead of running it")] = False
705	    no_apply: Annotated[bool, tyro.conf.arg(help="Render chezmoi.toml but skip `chezmoi apply` (for CI / Docker smoke tests)")] = False
706	
707	
708	@dataclass
709	class DoctorCmd:
710	    """Check that .chezmoi.toml.tmpl, Dockerfile, and this script agree on prompt keys."""
711	
712	    source: Annotated[Path, tyro.conf.arg(help="Path to chezmoi source dir")] = CHEZMOI_SOURCE_DIR
713	
714	
715	@dataclass
716	class ListBundlesCmd:
717	    """List available bundles and their overrides."""
718	
719	
720	Command = (
721	    Annotated[InitCmd, tyro.conf.subcommand(name="init")]
722	    | Annotated[DoctorCmd, tyro.conf.subcommand(name="doctor")]
723	    | Annotated[ListBundlesCmd, tyro.conf.subcommand(name="list-bundles")]
724	)
725	
726	
727	def run_init(cmd: InitCmd) -> int:
728	    pf = detect()
729	    print_preflight(pf)
730	
731	    # TTY is only required for interactive mode. --yes / --dry-run don't need one.
732	    if not cmd.yes and not cmd.dry_run and not pf.is_tty:
733	        console.print("[red]No TTY detected — cannot run interactive prompts.\n"
734	                      "If you piped this from curl, re-exec with `</dev/tty`.\n"

807	def _install_chezmoi_silent() -> str:
808	    """Non-interactive chezmoi install; same one-liner as install_chezmoi_interactive."""
809	    target = Path.home() / ".local" / "bin"

836	        console.print(t); console.print()

---
# .NET global tools installation
# .NET SDK is installed via mise (`mise use -g dotnet@<version>`), which puts
# a dotnet shim under ~/.local/share/mise/shims/dotnet and lets `dotnet tool
# install --global` drop binaries into ~/.dotnet/tools (hardcoded by dotnet).
# ~/.dotnet/tools is prepended to PATH by dot_config/zsh/00_exports.zsh when it
# exists.

# =============================================================================
# Ensure dotnet SDK is installed via mise
# =============================================================================

- name: Check for user-installed mise (dotnet_tools)
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin/mise"
  register: dotnet_mise_user_install

- name: Set mise binary path (dotnet_tools)
  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    dotnet_mise_bin: >-
      {{
        (ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] + '/.local/bin/mise')
        if dotnet_mise_user_install.stat.exists
        else ('/opt/homebrew/bin/mise' if ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Darwin' else '/usr/local/bin/mise')
      }}

- name: Verify mise binary is reachable (dotnet_tools)
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: "{{ dotnet_mise_bin }}"
  register: dotnet_mise_bin_stat

---
# .NET global tools installed via `dotnet tool install --global`.
# The .NET SDK itself is installed via mise (same pattern as rust_cargo_tools
# pulls in Rust via mise), so no system-level package manager or Microsoft apt
# repo is required -- everything lands under ~/.local/share/mise and
# ~/.dotnet/tools.
#
# Each entry:
#   - name:   NuGet package id (e.g. azure-cost-cli)
#   - binary: executable name to check for idempotency (e.g. azure-cost)

# mise channel/version for dotnet. "latest" tracks the newest stable SDK.
# Pin to e.g. "8" or "8.0" if a specific LTS is required.
dotnet_version: latest

dotnet_tools:
  - name: azure-cost-cli
    binary: azure-cost

---
# Install standalone JS/npm CLI utilities globally.
#
# Prefers `mise exec -- npm` because system npm on noRoot Linux hosts has its
# prefix at /usr/local (unwritable without sudo). mise's user-managed Node
# prefix works on both Linux and macOS without sudo. System npm is used only
# as a fallback when mise is unavailable.

- name: Detect whether npm is on PATH
  ansible.builtin.command: npm --version
  register: js_cli_npm_check
  changed_when: false
  failed_when: false

- name: Locate user-installed mise (js_cli_tools)
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin/mise"
  register: js_cli_mise_user_bin

- name: Set mise binary path (user install)
  when: js_cli_mise_user_bin.stat.exists | default(false)
  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    js_cli_mise_bin: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin/mise"

- name: Detect system-installed mise (js_cli_tools)
  when: js_cli_mise_bin is not defined
  ansible.builtin.command: mise --version
  register: js_cli_mise_system_check
  changed_when: false
  failed_when: false

3	# Implied parent dirs of managed files / externals (e.g. ~/.local when only
4	# ~/.local/share/toolkami/toolkami.rb is managed) inherit mode from
5	# `0o777 & ~umask`. Default umask is the user's login umask, which on macOS
6	# (002 → 0775) and various Linux distros (022 → 0755 / 0700 for ~) differs,
7	# producing recurring "mode-only diff" noise on .local and friends across
8	# the fleet. Pin umask to 022 so implied dirs are always 0755 regardless of
9	# host login umask. Files that need stricter modes use the `private_` prefix
10	# explicitly.

```text
1	# Freeze — code & terminal output → image
2	
3	[charmbracelet/freeze](https://github.com/charmbracelet/freeze) generates static images (PNG / SVG) of source code or arbitrary terminal output. Unlike VHS (which records sessions), Freeze is a one-shot snapshot — better for issue reports, blog posts, and PR thumbnails.
4	
5	- **Install**:
6	  - macOS — Homebrew (managed by `dot_ansible/roles/devtools/tasks/main.yml` macOS list)
7	  - Linux — GitHub release tarball into `~/.local/bin/freeze` (managed by `dot_ansible/roles/devtools/tasks/main.yml` `# --- freeze (Charm) ---` block)
8	- **Verify**: `freeze --version`
9	- **Status in this repo**: installed, no usage yet — pull it in when you next need a clean code screenshot.
10	
11	---
12	
13	## Two modes
14	
15	```bash
16	# 1) Source file → image (auto-detects language by extension)
17	freeze main.py --output code.png
18	freeze README.md --output readme.png
19	
20	# 2) Terminal output → image (-x runs the command and captures ANSI)
21	freeze --execute "ls -la" --output ls.png
22	freeze --execute "git log --oneline -n 10" --output gitlog.png
23	```
24	
25	Mode 1 is the everyday case (paste pretty code into Slack / Notion / a slide). Mode 2 is for when you specifically want the terminal aesthetic, ANSI colors and all.
26	
27	---
28	
29	## Common flags
30	
31	```bash
32	# Theme (Charm ships ~50 — see `freeze --help`)
33	freeze main.py -o code.png --theme "catppuccin-mocha"
34	
35	# Window decorations (mac-style traffic lights)
36	freeze main.py -o code.png --window
37	freeze main.py -o code.png --window --border.radius 8 --shadow.blur 20
38	
39	# Font + size
40	freeze main.py -o code.png --font.family "JetBrains Mono" --font.size 14
41	
42	# Line numbers + range
43	freeze main.py -o code.png --show-line-numbers --lines 10,40
44	
45	# Background + padding
46	freeze main.py -o code.png --background "#1E1E2E" --padding 30
47	
48	# Multiple in one go via config file
49	freeze --config ~/.config/freeze/default.json main.py -o code.png
50	```
51	
52	`freeze --help` lists every flag; the upstream README has a visual gallery of themes and window styles.
53	
54	---
55	
56	## Recommended config
57	
58	Save a per-user default so every screenshot has the same aesthetic without flag noise. Charm reads `~/.config/freeze/default.json` automatically when no `--config` is passed:
59	
60	```jsonc
61	// ~/.config/freeze/default.json — NOT managed by this repo (private)
62	{
63	  "theme": "catppuccin-mocha",
64	  "background": "#1E1E2E",
65	  "border": { "radius": 8, "thickness": 0 },
66	  "shadow": { "blur": 20, "x": 0, "y": 4 },
67	  "window": true,
68	  "padding": [20, 30],
69	  "margin": [0, 0],
70	  "font": { "family": "JetBrains Mono", "size": 14, "ligatures": true }
71	}
72	```
73	
74	Catppuccin Mocha matches this repo's tmux/starship default theme. If you switch to `tmux2k`, swap to `dracula` or `nord`.
75	
76	---
77	
78	## Usage patterns
79	
80	### Code review thumbnail
81	
82	```bash
83	# Snapshot the changed hunk for a PR cover image
84	git diff HEAD~1 -- src/foo.py | freeze --language diff -o /tmp/pr.png
85	```
86	
87	### Issue report
88	
89	```bash
90	# Bake the failing command + traceback into a single image
91	freeze --execute "pytest tests/test_broken.py" -o /tmp/issue.png
92	```
93	
94	`freeze --execute` runs the command, captures stdout AND stderr with ANSI colors preserved, then renders. Useful when the bug repro is "this colored output looks wrong".
95	
96	### Snippet from a long file
97	
98	```bash
99	freeze src/auth.py --lines 42,67 --show-line-numbers -o snippet.png
100	```
101	
102	`--lines` takes a comma-separated `start,end` (1-indexed). Combine with `--show-line-numbers` so reviewers can cross-reference the file.
103	
104	### SVG for blog posts
105	
106	```bash
107	freeze main.py -o code.svg
108	```
109	
110	SVG output is theme-aware (light/dark via media queries), scales infinitely, and is typically 5–10× smaller than the equivalent PNG. Drop into hugo/zola/jekyll posts and let the browser render.
111	
112	---
113	
114	## Where to use it in this repo (future)
115	
116	The repo has no `freeze`-generated images today. Plausible uses if/when adding visual docs:
117	
118	- `docs/playbooks/linux-gui-apps.md` — snippet of the decision-tree YAML
119	- `docs/this_repo/upgrades.md` — sample `just upgrade` output
120	- `docs/tools/aicapture.md` — `aifix` invocation with the highlighted prompt
121	- README — small SVG snippets of starship prompt / tmux status bar
122	
123	When you add one, drop the source `.png` / `.svg` next to the doc (e.g., `docs/playbooks/linux-gui-apps.snippet.png`) and reference relatively.
124	
125	---
126	
127	## Tips
128	
129	- **Determinism** — pin font, theme, padding via config so two screenshots of the same code byte-match. Aids review.
130	- **Font fallbacks** — if the named font isn't installed, `freeze` silently falls back to a built-in monospace. Install Nerd Fonts via this repo's `dot_ansible/roles/fonts/` if your config references one.
131	- **Width control** — long lines can wrap or get truncated. Use `--width` to force a column count (e.g., `--width 100`) or pre-format with `fmt -w 100`.
132	- **Don't snapshot secrets** — `freeze --execute` captures whatever the command prints. Same warning as VHS: skip `cat .env`, redact tokens before snapshotting.
133	
134	---
135	
136	## See also
137	
138	- [VHS](vhs.md) — for **moving** demos (terminal sessions → GIF / MP4)
139	- [Glow](glow.md), [Gum](gum.md) — the rest of the Charm CLI ecosystem

```text
1	# Freeze — 程式碼與終端機輸出 → 圖片
2	
3	!!! note "Terminology rule (zh-TW pages)"
4	    技術名詞首次出現以「中文 (English original)」格式呈現，例：依賴注入
5	    (dependency injection)。**不自創翻譯**——若無公認譯名直接保留英文
6	    （如 `embedding`、`tokenizer`）。代碼、API 名、CLI flag、套件名、檔名一律不翻。
7	
8	[charmbracelet/freeze](https://github.com/charmbracelet/freeze) 把原始碼或任意終端機 (terminal) 輸出產出靜態圖片（PNG / SVG）。和 VHS（錄工作階段）不同，Freeze 是一次性快照 — 適合 issue 回報、部落格貼文、PR 縮圖。
9	
10	- **安裝**：
11	  - macOS — Homebrew（由 `dot_ansible/roles/devtools/tasks/main.yml` 的 macOS 列表管理）
12	  - Linux — 從 GitHub release tarball 安裝到 `~/.local/bin/freeze`（由 `dot_ansible/roles/devtools/tasks/main.yml` 的 `# --- freeze (Charm) ---` 區塊管理）
13	- **驗證**：`freeze --version`
14	- **目前在這個 repo 的狀態**：已安裝、尚未使用 — 下次需要乾淨的程式碼截圖時拉進來。
15	
16	---
17	
18	## 兩種模式
19	
20	```bash
21	# 1) 原始碼檔 → 圖片（用副檔名自動偵測語言）
22	freeze main.py --output code.png
23	freeze README.md --output readme.png
24	
25	# 2) 終端機輸出 → 圖片 (-x 跑指令並抓 ANSI)
26	freeze --execute "ls -la" --output ls.png
27	freeze --execute "git log --oneline -n 10" --output gitlog.png
28	```
29	
30	模式 1 是日常情境（漂亮程式碼貼到 Slack / Notion / 投影片）。模式 2 是當你就要那種終端機質感、ANSI 顏色全保留的時候用。
31	
32	---
33	
34	## 常用 flag
35	
36	```bash
37	# 主題（Charm 內建約 50 個 — 詳 `freeze --help`）
38	freeze main.py -o code.png --theme "catppuccin-mocha"
39	
40	# Window 裝飾（mac 風格紅綠燈）
41	freeze main.py -o code.png --window
42	freeze main.py -o code.png --window --border.radius 8 --shadow.blur 20
43	
44	# 字型 + 大小
45	freeze main.py -o code.png --font.family "JetBrains Mono" --font.size 14
46	
47	# 行號 + 範圍
48	freeze main.py -o code.png --show-line-numbers --lines 10,40
49	
50	# 背景 + padding
51	freeze main.py -o code.png --background "#1E1E2E" --padding 30
52	
53	# 多個一次出貨用 config 檔
54	freeze --config ~/.config/freeze/default.json main.py -o code.png
55	```
56	
57	`freeze --help` 列出所有 flag；上游 README 有主題與 window 樣式的視覺長廊。
58	
59	---
60	
61	## 建議 config
62	
63	存一份個人預設，每張截圖都有相同美學而不必噴 flag。沒給 `--config` 時 Charm 會自動讀 `~/.config/freeze/default.json`：
64	
65	```jsonc
66	// ~/.config/freeze/default.json — 不由這個 repo 管理（私有）
67	{
68	  "theme": "catppuccin-mocha",
69	  "background": "#1E1E2E",
70	  "border": { "radius": 8, "thickness": 0 },
71	  "shadow": { "blur": 20, "x": 0, "y": 4 },
72	  "window": true,
73	  "padding": [20, 30],
74	  "margin": [0, 0],
75	  "font": { "family": "JetBrains Mono", "size": 14, "ligatures": true }
76	}
77	```
78	
79	Catppuccin Mocha 與 repo 的 tmux/starship 預設主題一致。如果你切到 `tmux2k`，改成 `dracula` 或 `nord`。
80	
81	---
82	
83	## 用法 patterns
84	
85	### Code review 縮圖
86	
87	```bash
88	# 把改動的 hunk 拍起來當 PR cover image
89	git diff HEAD~1 -- src/foo.py | freeze --language diff -o /tmp/pr.png
90	```
91	
92	### Issue 回報
93	
94	```bash
95	# 把失敗指令 + traceback 烤成一張圖
96	freeze --execute "pytest tests/test_broken.py" -o /tmp/issue.png
97	```
98	
99	`freeze --execute` 跑指令、抓帶 ANSI 顏色的 stdout 與 stderr，然後渲染。當 bug 重現是「這段彩色輸出不對」時很好用。
100	
101	### 長檔的片段
102	
103	```bash
104	freeze src/auth.py --lines 42,67 --show-line-numbers -o snippet.png
105	```
106	
107	`--lines` 接逗號分隔的 `start,end`（1-indexed）。配合 `--show-line-numbers` 讓審查者能對照原檔。
108	
109	### 部落格用 SVG
110	
111	```bash
112	freeze main.py -o code.svg
113	```
114	
115	SVG 輸出感知主題（透過 media query 切 light/dark）、無限縮放、通常比 PNG 小 5–10 倍。丟進 hugo / zola / jekyll，瀏覽器自己渲染。
116	
117	---
118	
119	## 在這個 repo 何處用得到（未來）
120	
121	目前 repo 沒有 `freeze` 產生的圖。要加視覺文件時可能的位置：
122	
123	- `docs/playbooks/linux-gui-apps.md` — decision-tree YAML 片段
124	- `docs/this_repo/upgrades.md` — `just upgrade` 範例輸出
125	- `docs/tools/aicapture.md` — `aifix` 呼叫帶高亮 prompt
126	- README — starship prompt / tmux status bar 的小張 SVG 片段
127	
128	加的時候把原始 `.png` / `.svg` 與 doc 並列（例如 `docs/playbooks/linux-gui-apps.snippet.png`），用相對路徑引用。
129	
130	---
131	
132	## 提示
133	
134	- **確定性** — 用 config 釘住字型、主題、padding，這樣同一段程式碼兩次截圖能 byte-identical。利於審查。
135	- **字型 fallback** — 指定的字型沒裝時，`freeze` 會靜默 fallback 到內建 monospace。若 config 引用 Nerd Font，請從 `dot_ansible/roles/fonts/` 安裝。
136	- **寬度控制** — 長行可能 wrap 或被截。用 `--width` 強制行數（如 `--width 100`）或先用 `fmt -w 100` 預處理。
137	- **不要拍機密** — `freeze --execute` 抓的是指令印出的東西。同 VHS 警告：跳過 `cat .env`，截圖前先 redact token。
138	
139	---
140	
141	## 另見
142	
143	- [VHS](vhs.md) — **動態** demo（終端機 session → GIF / MP4）
144	- [Glow](glow.md)、[Gum](gum.md) — 其餘 Charm CLI 生態系
145	- [`bat`](https://github.com/sharkdp/bat) — 純終端機語法高亮輸出（不出圖）
146
```
</details></tool-use>

12	# retry. Without retries, a single `curl: (18) Transferred a partial file`
13	# would fail the whole task. Tools also install independently so one failure
14	# doesn't block the others. For GFW users: set `HOMEBREW_BOTTLE_DOMAIN` to a
15	# mirror (see docs/tools/infrastructure-as-code.md).

94	# --- Azure CLI via Microsoft apt repo ---
95	- name: Install Azure CLI from Microsoft apt repo (Debian/Ubuntu)
96	  when:
97	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
98	    - iac_install_azure_cli
99	  become: true
100	  tags: [sudo]
101	  block:
102	    - name: Install Azure CLI prerequisites
103	      ansible.builtin.apt:
104	        name:
105	          - ca-certificates
106	          - curl
107	          - gnupg
108	          - lsb-release
109	        state: present
110	
111	    - name: Create keyrings directory for Azure CLI
112	      ansible.builtin.file:
113	        path: /etc/apt/keyrings
114	        state: directory
115	        mode: '0755'
116	
117	    - name: Download Microsoft signing key
118	      ansible.builtin.shell: |
119	        curl -sLS https://packages.microsoft.com/keys/microsoft.asc | gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/microsoft.gpg
120	        chmod go+r /etc/apt/keyrings/microsoft.gpg
121	      args:
122	        executable: /bin/bash
123	        creates: /etc/apt/keyrings/microsoft.gpg
124	
125	    - name: Add Azure CLI apt repository
126	      ansible.builtin.shell: |

194	# --- OpenTofu via official deb repo ---
195	- name: Install OpenTofu from official repo (Debian/Ubuntu)
196	  when:
197	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
198	    - iac_install_opentofu
199	  become: true
200	  tags: [sudo]
201	  block:
202	    - name: Install OpenTofu prerequisites
203	      ansible.builtin.apt:
204	        name:
205	          - curl
206	          - gnupg
207	        state: present
208	
209	    - name: Create keyrings directory for OpenTofu
210	      ansible.builtin.file:
211	        path: /etc/apt/keyrings
212	        state: directory
213	        mode: '0755'
214	
215	    # Single-key setup: the `InRelease` file is signed by the key at
216	    # packages.opentofu.org/.../gpgkey (subkey 70DF59811A8B9109). The old
217	    # dual-key approach also included get.opentofu.org/opentofu.gpg, but that
218	    # is an unrelated OpenTofu project key that does NOT sign the repo —
219	    # carrying it in signed-by= bought nothing. `deb-src` is dropped because
220	    # this Cloudsmith-style repo has no source packages and apt-get update
221	    # fails on the missing Sources file.
222	    - name: Install OpenTofu repo and package
223	      ansible.builtin.shell: |
224	        set -eo pipefail
225	        # gpg --dearmor -o <file> refuses to overwrite without --yes; on a
226	        # re-apply the keyring file exists from the previous run. Use --yes
227	        # so the task is idempotent.
228	        curl -fsSL https://packages.opentofu.org/opentofu/tofu/gpgkey \
229	          | gpg --no-tty --batch --yes --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/opentofu.gpg
230	        # Clean up the orphan keyring from the old dual-key layout so a
231	        # stale sources.list entry referencing it cannot wedge apt-get update.
232	        rm -f /etc/apt/keyrings/opentofu-repo.gpg
233	        echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/opentofu.gpg] https://packages.opentofu.org/opentofu/tofu/any/ any main" \
234	          > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/opentofu.list
235	        apt-get update
236	        apt-get install -y tofu
237	      args:
238	        executable: /bin/bash
239	      changed_when: true
240	  rescue:

243	        msg: "OpenTofu installation failed — skipping. Error: {{ ansible_failed_result.msg | default('unknown') }}"

It headlessly replays your typed commands inside a virtual terminal and produces a deterministic, reviewable artifact — perfect for README demos, bug reproductions, and PR review aids.
4	
5	- **Install**:
6	  - macOS — Homebrew (managed by `dot_ansible/roles/devtools/tasks/main.yml` macOS list). On macOS, Homebrew also pulls in `ttyd` and `ffmpeg` automatically as runtime deps.
7	  - Linux — GitHub release tarball into `~/.local/bin/vhs` (managed by `dot_ansible/roles/devtools/tasks/main.yml` `# --- vhs (Charm) ---` block). **Runtime deps `ttyd` and `ffmpeg` are NOT auto-installed** — see [Linux runtime dependencies](#linux-runtime-dependencies) below.
8	- **Verify**: `vhs --version`
9	- **Status in this repo**: installed, no `.tape` files yet. Create them under `docs/_demos/*.tape` if you start recording.
10	
11	---
12	
13	## Hello world
14	
15	```bash
16	cat <<'TAPE' > /tmp/hello.tape
17	Output /tmp/hello.gif
18	Set FontSize 18
19	Set Width 800
20	Set Height 400
21	Type "echo Hello, VHS"
22	Enter
23	Sleep 1s
24	TAPE
25	
26	vhs /tmp/hello.tape
27	file /tmp/hello.gif    # → GIF image data
28	```
29	
30	Open the GIF in any image viewer (`open` on macOS, `xdg-open` on Linux, or drop into Slack / a PR description).
31	
32	---
33	
34	## Linux runtime dependencies
35	
36	`vhs` shells out to `ttyd` (web-based PTY) and `ffmpeg` (video encoder). On Linux these are usually missing — install them once on each host that will record:
37	
38	```bash
39	# Ubuntu / Debian
40	sudo apt install ffmpeg
41	# ttyd has no .deb in the default repos — use the prebuilt static binary:
42	curl -L "https://github.com/tsl0922/ttyd/releases/latest/download/ttyd.$(uname -m)" \
43	  -o ~/.local/bin/ttyd && chmod +x ~/.local/bin/ttyd
44	
45	# Verify
46	ttyd --version
47	ffmpeg -version | head -1
48	```
49	
50	The ansible role deliberately does NOT auto-install these — `ffmpeg` is a heavy dep (50+ MB transitively) and `ttyd` doesn't have a clean apt path on every supported Ubuntu release. Recording is opt-in, so the dep install is opt-in too.
51	
52	If `vhs` runs but produces a 0-byte output, that's almost always a missing `ttyd` or `ffmpeg`. `vhs --help` lists the path it expects.
53	
54	---
55	
56	## `.tape` script primer
57	
58	A `.tape` file is a flat list of commands. Highlights:
59	
60	```text
61	# Output target (one per file)
62	Output demo.gif
63	# Output demo.webm    # also supported
64	# Output frames/      # dump individual PNG frames
65	
66	# Settings (apply to whole tape)
67	Set Shell zsh
68	Set FontSize 16
69	Set FontFamily "MonoLisa, JetBrainsMono Nerd Font"
70	Set Theme "Catppuccin Mocha"
71	Set Width 1200
72	Set Height 600
73	Set Padding 20
74	Set TypingSpeed 50ms
75	Set PlaybackSpeed 1.0
76	Set LoopOffset 0%
77	
78	# Hide setup commands (typed but not shown in output)
79	Hide
80	Type "cd ~/scratch && clear"
81	Enter
82	Show
83	
84	# Visible interactions
85	Type "ls -la"
86	Enter
87	Sleep 1s
88	
89	Type "echo waiting"
90	Enter
91	Sleep 500ms
92	
93	# Press special keys
94	Ctrl+C
95	Backspace 5
96	Enter
97	Tab
98	Escape
99	
100	# Wait for a prompt regex before continuing (vhs ≥ 0.7)
101	Wait /\$\s$/
102	```
103	
104	Full reference: `vhs --help` and the upstream `examples/` directory.
105	
106	---
107	
108	## Recording a real workflow demo
109	
110	Skeleton for showing off something this repo actually does — e.g., `fleet-apply`:
111	
112	```text
113	# docs/_demos/fleet-apply.tape
114	Output fleet-apply.gif
115	Set Shell zsh
116	Set FontSize 16
117	Set Theme "Catppuccin Mocha"
118	Set Width 1400
119	Set Height 800
120	Set TypingSpeed 60ms
121	
122	Hide
123	Type "cd ~/.local/share/chezmoi && clear"
124	Enter
125	Show
126	
127	Type "just fleet-apply --status"
128	Enter
129	Sleep 3s
130	
131	Type "just fleet-apply"
132	Enter
133	Sleep 8s
134	
135	Type 'q'    # exit watch view
136	```
137	
138	Then commit the `.tape` (small, reviewable) and the rendered `.gif` (binary, large but reviewable in PR diff). Keep tapes deterministic — avoid commands that hit the network or clocks unless that's the point of the demo.
139	
140	---
141	
142	## Where to put tapes
143	
144	This repo doesn't have an established convention yet. When you record the first one, suggested layout:
145	
146	```
147	docs/_demos/
148	  fleet-apply.tape
149	  fleet-apply.gif
150	  sesh-tmux.tape
151	  sesh-tmux.gif
152	```
153	
154	Underscore prefix keeps it out of the MkDocs nav. Embed in a doc page with a normal markdown image:
155	
156	```markdown
157	![fleet-apply demo](../_demos/fleet-apply.gif)
158	```
159	
160	If GIFs end up large (> 5 MB), reach for `Output demo.mp4` and embed via raw HTML — most browsers play inline MP4 in markdown viewers, and the file is typically 3–10× smaller.
161	
162	---
163	
164	## Tips
165	
166	- **Reproducible recordings** — pin `Set TypingSpeed`, `Set PlaybackSpeed`, and avoid wall-clock-dependent commands. Two `vhs run X.tape` invocations should produce byte-identical output.
167	- **Catppuccin theme** — `Set Theme "Catppuccin Mocha"` matches this repo's tmux / starship aesthetic.
168	- **`vhs serve`** — runs a local HTTP UI for iterating on a tape. Saves the round-trip of `vhs file && open file.gif`.
169	- **CI rendering** — keep `.tape` source-of-truth and re-render `.gif` in CI on demand. The repo doesn't currently do this; would need `ffmpeg` + `ttyd` in the CI image.
170	- **Don't record secrets** — `vhs` captures whatever is on screen; use `Hide` blocks around any `cat ~/.env` or `gh auth status` that prints tokens.
171	
172	---
173	
174	## See also
175	
176	- [Glow](glow.md), [Gum](gum.md), [Freeze](freeze.md) — the rest of the Charm CLI ecosystem
177	- [Freeze](freeze.md) — for **static** code/output screenshots, where a GIF is overkill
178
```
</details></tool-use>

76	    eval "$("$HOME/.linuxbrew/bin/brew" shellenv)"
77	fi

219	# shared helper so the non-TTY child process finds a live ticket.
220	if [[ "$NEED_SUDO" == "1" ]]; then
221	    if sudo_session_init "ansible"; then
222	        case "$(sudo_session_skip_reason)" in
223	            cached)
224	                # Refresh the current TTY's sudo timestamp so the cask child
225	                # `sudo /usr/sbin/installer` finds a live ticket (it does not
226	                # accept a piped password). The watchdog keeps it warm every 50s.
227	                sudo_session_warm_cache || warn "sudo_session_warm_cache failed; pkg casks may still prompt"
228	                ;;
229	            passwordless)
```

### 5. noRoot Flag Pattern

**Exact conditional pattern** (used across roles):

```yaml
# System-level task (requires sudo)
- name: Install package via apt
  when:
    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
    - not noRoot  # ← Gate: skip if noRoot=true
  become: true
  tags: [sudo]

# OR explicit role default (e.g., llm_tools)
- name: Install Ollama (system-level)
  when:
    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
    - not (llm_tools_no_root | bool)  # ← User-provided role-level default
  become: true
  tags: [sudo]

# User-level fallback (always runs regardless of noRoot)
- name: Install binary to ~/.local/bin
  when:
    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
    - tool_check.rc != 0  # Not installed
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin"
```

The `noRoot` value is set in `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl:74` and passed to ansible. Roles that consume it check the variable; those without explicit checks have no `become: true` or `tags: [sudo]`, making them user-level by default.

**Which tools should the new `installMediaTools` bundle install?**

Options:
- **All four (Recommended)** - ffmpeg + imagemagick + exiftool + libvips. Mirrors the ChatGPT recommendation. Single role, single prompt.
- **Three core** - ffmpeg + imagemagick + exiftool. Skip libvips (heavier, niche — only matters for tens of thousands of images).
- **ffmpeg only** - Just ffmpeg. Smallest bundle; resolves the vhs runtime-dep gap and nothing else.
- **Split into two prompts** - `installMediaTools` (ffmpeg + imagemagick + exiftool) + a separate `installVipsTools` (libvips). More UX surface.

**Should the same change also add bilingual docs pages (`docs/tools/{ffmpeg,imagemagick,exiftool,vips}.md` + zh-TW pairs) and wire them into mkdocs.yml?**

Options:
- **Defer docs (Recommended)** - Plan only covers the install plumbing. Docs come in a follow-up commit after you decide narrative angles. Keeps this PR small and reviewable.
- **Include docs in same plan** - Plan grows by 8 .md files + mkdocs.yml nav + nav_translations entries. Bigger commit but ships the feature complete.
- **Stub docs only** - Create skeleton pages (heading + Install + Verify + 'See also') so the nav is wired, then fill them in later. Avoids broken nav links if mkdocs --strict is run.

**Should the plan also add convenience zsh functions (`compress-video`, `extract-audio`, `to-wav16k`) from the ChatGPT conversation into `dot_config/zsh/`?**

Options:
- **No (Recommended)** - Stay focused on the install bundle. Aliases can be added later (and per the repo's aliases doc rule, they'd require updating `docs/zsh/aliases.md` in the same commit).
- **Yes, add the three functions** - Add a new `dot_config/zsh/tools/<NN>_media.zsh` with the three functions and update `docs/zsh/aliases.md`.

10	"""
11	dotfiles_init.py — Interactive wrapper around `chezmoi init` inspired by
12	Vercel Labs' `skills` CLI (https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills).
13	
14	The existing `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl` defines ~19 prompts (profile, email, name,
15	16 feature flags). `chezmoi init` asks them sequentially, which works but
16	hides the feature flags from each other and makes "set up a new machine
17	the way I always do" a manual checklist. This wrapper:
18	
19	  1. Pre-flights chezmoi / git / SSH key and offers to fix gaps.
20	  2. Lets you pick a pre-configured BUNDLE (personal-mac, work-mac,
21	     server-linux, minimal) that ticks typical feature flags for you.
22	  3. Presents feature flags grouped, as a questionary multi-select you can
23	     fly through with Space + Enter.
24	  4. Shells out to `chezmoi init <repo> --apply [--ssh] --promptString ... `
25	     so chezmoi remains the source of truth — we just pre-answer its prompts.
26	  5. Streams chezmoi's output live and prints a recap at the end.
27	
28	The wrapper also has a `doctor` subcommand that greps `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl`
29	and `Dockerfile` and fails loudly if any prompt key in those files is
30	missing from this script's PROMPTS list (or vice versa). Run it in CI / a
31	pre-commit hook to catch drift — per CLAUDE.md's "Dockerfile" cross-file
32	rule, adding a chezmoi prompt means updating three files in one commit.
33	
34	Invocation:

269	        "installCodingAgents": False,

271	        "installAiDesktopApps": False,
272	        "installPythonUvTools": False,
273	        "installJsCliTools": False,

293	# Pre-flight

295	
296	@dataclass
297	class Preflight:
298	    chezmoi: str | None
299	    git: str | None
300	    ssh_hint: str | None                # how we detected SSH is ready (or None)
301	    source_exists: bool
302	    os_name: str
303	    is_tty: bool
304	
305	
306	def _detect_ssh() -> str | None:
307	    """Return a short hint describing why we think SSH-to-github is configured,
308	    or None if we can't tell. We accept several signals because the user may
309	    keep keys under non-canonical names and route them via ~/.ssh/config or
310	    its Include'd fragments."""
311	    # (1) Canonical default keys.
312	    for k in SSH_DEFAULT_KEYS:
313	        if k.exists():
314	            return f"default key at {k}"
315	    # (2) ~/.ssh/config (or an Include'd file under ~/.ssh/config.d/) with a
316	    # `Host github…` stanza → user is routing a custom key.
317	    config_texts: list[str] = []
318	    for root in (SSH_CONFIG, *((SSH_DIR / "config.d").glob("*") if (SSH_DIR / "config.d").is_dir() else ())):
319	        if root.is_file():
320	            try:
321	                config_texts.append(root.read_text(errors="replace"))
322	            except OSError:
323	                pass
324	    joined = "\n".join(config_texts)
325	    if re.search(r"(?mi)^\s*Host\s+[\w.\-\* ]*github", joined):
326	        return "~/.ssh/config routes github.com"
327	    # (3) Any loaded key in the agent (default or via IdentityAgent socket).
328	    try:
329	        r = subprocess.run(["ssh-add", "-l"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=3)
330	        if r.returncode == 0 and r.stdout.strip():
331	            return "ssh-agent has keys loaded"
332	    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
333	        pass
334	    return None
335	
336	
337	def detect() -> Preflight:
338	    import platform
339	    return Preflight(
340	        chezmoi=shutil.which("chezmoi"),
341	        git=shutil.which("git"),
342	        ssh_hint=_detect_ssh(),
343	        source_exists=(CHEZMOI_SOURCE_DIR / ".git").is_dir(),
344	        os_name={"Darwin": "darwin", "Linux": "linux"}.get(platform.system(), platform.system().lower()),
345	        is_tty=sys.stdin.isatty() and sys.stdout.isatty(),
346	    )

349	def print_preflight(pf: Preflight) -> None:
350	    t = Table(title="Preflight", show_header=False, box=None, padding=(0, 2))
351	    t.add_column(); t.add_column()
352	    t.add_row("chezmoi", "✓ " + pf.chezmoi if pf.chezmoi else "✗ [red]not found[/red]")
353	    t.add_row("git", "✓ " + pf.git if pf.git else "✗ [red]not found[/red]")
354	    t.add_row("SSH", f"✓ {pf.ssh_hint}" if pf.ssh_hint else "✗ [yellow]no signal found[/yellow]")
355	    t.add_row("chezmoi source", "✓ present (re-init mode)" if pf.source_exists else "– fresh init")
356	    console.print(t)
357	    console.print()

360	def install_chezmoi_interactive(os_name: str) -> str:
361	    """Offer to install chezmoi via the canonical one-liner; return new path."""
362	    if not questionary.confirm("chezmoi not found. Install via get.chezmoi.io/lb?", default=True).ask():
363	        console.print("[red]chezmoi is required; aborting.[/red]")
364	        sys.exit(1)
365	    target = Path.home() / ".local" / "bin"
366	    target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
367	    subprocess.check_call(
368	        "curl -fsLS --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 get.chezmoi.io/lb | sh",
369	        shell=True,
370	        env={**os.environ, "BINDIR": str(target)},
371	    )
372	    path = shutil.which("chezmoi") or str(target / "chezmoi")
373	    console.print(f"[green]chezmoi installed at {path}[/green]\n")
374	    return path

376	
377	def ensure_ssh_key_interactive() -> Path | None:
378	    """Offer to generate an ed25519 key; return path or None if user declined."""
379	    if not questionary.confirm(
380	        "No SSH key found. Generate ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 for GitHub (SSH clone)?",
381	        default=True,
382	    ).ask():
383	        return None
384	    key_path = Path.home() / ".ssh" / "id_ed25519"
385	    key_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
386	    email = questionary.text(
387	        "Email to tag the SSH key with:",
388	        default="daviddwlee84@gmail.com",
389	    ).ask() or "daviddwlee84@gmail.com"
390	    subprocess.check_call(["ssh-keygen", "-t", "ed25519", "-C", email, "-f", str(key_path), "-N", ""])
391	    pub = key_path.with_suffix(".pub").read_text().strip()
392	    console.print(Panel(
393	        f"[bold]Add this public key to GitHub → Settings → SSH keys:[/bold]\n\n{pub}\n\n"
394	        f"Open: https://github.com/settings/ssh/new",
395	        title="SSH key generated",
396	        border_style="green",
397	    ))
398	    questionary.press_any_key_to_continue("Press any key once you've added the key to GitHub...").ask()
399	    return key_path

406	def ask_bundle() -> str:
407	    choices = [
408	        questionary.Choice(
409	            title=f"{name:<14} — {summary}",
410	            value=name,
411	        )
412	        for name, summary in [
413	            ("personal-mac", "full personal setup (AI desktop apps, LLM tools, Brewfile)"),
414	            ("work-mac",     "safer: coding agents + dev tooling, no personal AI apps"),
415	            ("server-linux", "headless linux — coding agents, networking, dev tooling"),
416	            ("minimal",      "dotfiles only, no installX flags"),
417	            ("custom",       "no overrides — tick every feature yourself"),
418	        ]
419	    ]
420	    return questionary.select(
421	        "Pick a bundle:",
422	        choices=choices,
423	        default=choices[0],
424	    ).ask() or "custom"

427	def ask_basics(pf: Preflight, overrides: dict[str, object]) -> dict[str, object]:
428	    # profile: auto-detect on Darwin; ask ubuntu_desktop vs ubuntu_server on Linux
429	    default_profile = "macos" if pf.os_name == "darwin" else "ubuntu_server"
430	    if pf.os_name == "darwin":
431	        profile = "macos"
432	        console.print(f"[dim]profile → {profile} (auto-detected)[/dim]")
433	    else:
434	        profile = questionary.select(
435	            "Which profile?",
436	            choices=["ubuntu_server", "ubuntu_desktop"],
437	            default=overrides.get("profile", default_profile),
438	        ).ask() or default_profile
439	
440	    name = questionary.text(
441	        "Your full name:",
442	        default=str(overrides.get("name", _default_for("name"))),
443	    ).ask() or _default_for("name")
444	
445	    email = questionary.text(
446	        "Your git email:",
447	        default=str(overrides.get("email", _default_for("email"))),
448	    ).ask() or _default_for("email")
449	
450	    return {"profile": profile, "name": name, "email": email}
451	
452	
453	def resolve_basics_non_interactive(
454	    pf: Preflight,
455	    overrides: dict[str, object],
456	    *,
457	    name_flag: str | None,
458	    email_flag: str | None,
459	    profile_flag: str | None,
460	) -> dict[str, object]:
461	    """Non-interactive basics: flag → bundle override → embedded default → OS auto-detect."""
462	    if profile_flag:
463	        profile = profile_flag
464	    elif "profile" in overrides:
465	        profile = overrides["profile"]
466	    else:
467	        profile = "macos" if pf.os_name == "darwin" else "ubuntu_server"
468	    name = name_flag or overrides.get("name") or _default_for("name")
469	    email = email_flag or overrides.get("email") or _default_for("email")
470	    return {"profile": profile, "name": name, "email": email}
471	
472	
473	def resolve_features_non_interactive(pf: Preflight, overrides: dict[str, object]) -> dict[str, bool]:
474	    """Non-interactive features: bundle override → embedded default, skipping darwin-only on Linux."""
475	    result: dict[str, bool] = {}
476	    for p in PROMPTS:
477	        if p.kind != "bool" or p.hidden:
478	            continue
479	        if p.darwin_only and pf.os_name != "darwin":
480	            continue
481	        result[p.key] = bool(overrides.get(p.key, p.default))
482	    return result
483	
484	
485	def ask_features(pf: Preflight, overrides: dict[str, object]) -> dict[str, bool]:
486	    """Grouped multi-select. Returns {key: bool} for every non-basics bool prompt."""
487	    feature_prompts = [p for p in PROMPTS if p.kind == "bool" and not p.hidden
488	                       and (pf.os_name == "darwin" or not p.darwin_only)]
489	
490	    groups: dict[str, list[Prompt]] = {}
491	    for p in feature_prompts:
492	        groups.setdefault(p.group, []).append(p)
493	
494	    # Build one flat checkbox preserving group order, with group headers as
495	    # disabled separator rows (purely visual).
496	    choices: list[questionary.Choice] = []
497	    for group, prompts in groups.items():
498	        choices.append(questionary.Separator(f"── {group} ──"))
499	        for p in prompts:
500	            initial = overrides.get(p.key, p.default)
501	            choices.append(questionary.Choice(
502	                title=f"{p.label}  — {p.desc}",
503	                value=p.key,
504	                checked=bool(initial),
505	            ))
506	
507	    console.print()
508	    console.print("[bold]Feature flags[/bold] — Space to toggle, ↑/↓ to move, Enter to confirm.")
509	    selected_keys = questionary.checkbox(
510	        "Which features?",
511	        choices=choices,
512	    ).ask() or []
513	
514	    result: dict[str, bool] = {}
515	    for p in feature_prompts:
516	        result[p.key] = p.key in selected_keys
517	    return result
518	
519	
520	def confirm_plan(answers: dict[str, object], argv: list[str]) -> bool:
521	    t = Table(title="Answers", show_header=False, box=None, padding=(0, 2))
522	    t.add_column("Key", style="cyan"); t.add_column("Value")
523	    for p in PROMPTS:
524	        if p.darwin_only and p.key not in answers:
525	            continue
526	        val = answers.get(p.key)
527	        style = "green" if val is True else ("dim" if val is False else "")
528	        t.add_row(p.key, f"[{style}]{val}[/{style}]" if style else str(val))
529	    console.print(t)
530	    console.print()
531	    console.print(Panel(
532	        " ".join(argv),
533	        title="Command about to run",
534	        border_style="blue",
535	    ))
536	    return questionary.confirm("Proceed?", default=True).ask() or False

539	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
540	# Runner
541	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
542	
543	def build_chezmoi_argv(
544	    answers: dict[str, object],
545	    *,
546	    chezmoi_bin: str,
547	    repo: str | None,
548	    use_ssh: bool,
549	    apply: bool,
550	    darwin: bool,
551	) -> list[str]:
552	    """Build the chezmoi init argv. The critical detail is that `chezmoi init`
553	    matches --promptBool / --promptString / --promptChoice flags by the PROMPT
554	    TEXT (3rd arg to promptXOnce in the template), NOT the key name. That's
555	    why every Prompt carries a prompt_text field and we use it here as the
556	    flag key."""
557	    argv: list[str] = [chezmoi_bin, "init"]
558	    if repo:
559	        argv.append(repo)
560	    if use_ssh:
561	        argv.append("--ssh")
562	    if apply:
563	        argv.append("--apply")
564	    by_key = {p.key: p for p in PROMPTS}
565	    # String + choice prompts (basics).
566	    for key in ("email", "name"):
567	        if key in answers:
568	            argv += ["--promptString", f"{by_key[key].prompt_text}={answers[key]}"]
569	    if "profile" in answers:
570	        argv += ["--promptChoice", f"{by_key['profile'].prompt_text}={answers['profile']}"]
571	    # Non-basics choice prompts (e.g. discordChannel).
572	    for p in PROMPTS:
573	        if p.kind != "choice" or p.hidden:
574	            continue
575	        if p.darwin_only and not darwin:
576	            continue
577	        if p.key not in answers:
578	            continue
579	        argv += ["--promptChoice", f"{p.prompt_text}={answers[p.key]}"]
580	    # Bool prompts — skip darwin-only on linux (chezmoi never evaluates them there).
581	    for p in PROMPTS:
582	        if p.kind != "bool" or p.hidden:
583	            continue
584	        if p.darwin_only and not darwin:
585	            continue
586	        if p.key not in answers:
587	            continue
588	        val_str = "true" if answers[p.key] else "false"
589	        argv += ["--promptBool", f"{p.prompt_text}={val_str}"]
590	    return argv
591	
592	
593	def run_chezmoi(argv: list[str]) -> int:
594	    console.print(f"[dim]$ {' '.join(argv)}[/dim]")
595	    console.rule("[bold]chezmoi output[/bold]")
596	    rc = subprocess.call(argv)
597	    console.rule()
598	    return rc
599	
600	
601	def print_recap(answers: dict[str, object], rc: int) -> None:
602	    enabled = [p.label for p in PROMPTS if p.kind == "bool" and not p.hidden and answers.get(p.key)]
603	    panel_body = (
604	        f"{'✓' if rc == 0 else '✗'} chezmoi init exit={rc}\n"
605	        f"✓ {len(enabled)} of {sum(1 for p in PROMPTS if p.kind == 'bool' and not p.hidden)} feature groups enabled\n"
606	        f"\nEnabled:\n  " + ("\n  ".join(enabled) if enabled else "(none)")
607	        + "\n\nNext:\n  • Review with: chezmoi diff\n"
608	          "  • Upgrade later with: just upgrade-all\n"
609	          "  • Fleet-apply to other hosts with: just fleet-apply"
610	    )
611	    console.print(Panel(
612	        panel_body,
613	        title="Summary",
614	        border_style="green" if rc == 0 else "red",
615	    ))

618	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
619	# Doctor: schema parity check
620	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
621	
622	def doctor_scan(source_dir: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, str], set[str], dict[str, str]]:
623	    """Return (tmpl: {key: prompt_text}, dockerfile_keys, script: {key: prompt_text})."""
624	    tmpl = (source_dir / ".chezmoi.toml.tmpl").read_text()
625	    tmpl_pairs: dict[str, str] = {}
626	    for k, txt in re.findall(
627	        r'prompt(?:String|Bool|Choice)Once\s+\.\s+"(\w+)"\s+"([^"]+)"', tmpl):
628	        tmpl_pairs[k] = txt
629	
630	    dockerfile = (source_dir / "Dockerfile").read_text()
631	    def _arg_to_camel(s: str) -> str:
632	        parts = s.lower().split("_")
633	        return parts[0] + "".join(p.title() for p in parts[1:])
634	    docker_args = re.findall(r"ARG\s+CHEZMOI_(\w+)\s*=", dockerfile)
635	    docker_keys = {_arg_to_camel(a) for a in docker_args if a.lower() != "repo"}
636	
637	    script_pairs = {p.key: p.prompt_text for p in PROMPTS}
638	    return tmpl_pairs, docker_keys, script_pairs
639	
640	
641	def doctor_report(source_dir: Path) -> int:
642	    tmpl, docker, script = doctor_scan(source_dir)
643	    all_keys = set(tmpl) | docker | set(script)
644	
645	    rows = []
646	    drift = False
647	    for k in sorted(all_keys):
648	        in_t = "✓" if k in tmpl else "[red]✗[/red]"
649	        in_d = "✓" if k in docker else "[yellow]✗[/yellow]"
650	        in_s = "✓" if k in script else "[red]✗[/red]"
651	        if not (k in tmpl and k in docker and k in script):
652	            drift = True
653	        text_note = ""
654	        # Prompt-text mismatches are critical — chezmoi init matches on the text.
655	        if k in tmpl and k in script and tmpl[k] != script[k]:
656	            drift = True
657	            text_note = f"[red]text mismatch[/red]"
658	        rows.append((k, in_t, in_d, in_s, text_note))
659	
660	    t = Table(title="Prompt schema parity")
661	    t.add_column("key"); t.add_column(".chezmoi.toml.tmpl")
662	    t.add_column("Dockerfile"); t.add_column("dotfiles_init.py")
663	    t.add_column("notes")
664	    for row in rows:
665	        t.add_row(*row)
666	    console.print(t)
667	
668	    if drift:
669	        console.print("[red]Drift detected — update the missing files so all three agree.[/red]")
670	        console.print("[dim]Prompt-text mismatches are especially important — chezmoi init\n"
671	                      "matches --promptBool flags by the full prompt text, not the key.[/dim]")
672	        return 1
673	    console.print("[green]All three surfaces agree (keys + prompt texts).[/green]")
674	    return 0
675	
676

678	# CLI
679	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
680	
681	def _default_for(key: str) -> object:
682	    for p in PROMPTS:
683	        if p.key == key:
684	            return p.default
685	    raise KeyError(key)
686	
687	
688	@dataclass
689	class InitCmd:
690	    """Interactive wrapper around `chezmoi init`.
691	
692	    With --yes (and optionally --bundle / --name / --email / --profile) the
693	    flow becomes fully non-interactive: no TTY required, no prompts shown.
694	    Suitable for Docker / CI. Missing basics fall back to bundle overrides,
695	    then embedded defaults, then OS auto-detection for profile."""
696	
697	    repo: Annotated[str, tyro.conf.arg(help="Chezmoi repo arg (omit on re-init)")] = DEFAULT_REPO
698	    bundle: Annotated[str | None, tyro.conf.arg(help="Skip the picker; use this bundle")] = None
699	    name: Annotated[str | None, tyro.conf.arg(help="Git full name (non-interactive override)")] = None
700	    email: Annotated[str | None, tyro.conf.arg(help="Git email (non-interactive override)")] = None
701	    profile: Annotated[str | None, tyro.conf.arg(help="Profile: macos|ubuntu_desktop|ubuntu_server (auto-detected if omitted)")] = None
702	    ssh: Annotated[bool, tyro.conf.arg(help="Force --ssh even if no key is present")] = False
703	    yes: Annotated[bool, tyro.conf.arg(help="Fully non-interactive: no prompts, no confirmation, assume defaults")] = False
704	    dry_run: Annotated[bool, tyro.conf.arg(help="Print the chezmoi command instead of running it")] = False
705	    no_apply: Annotated[bool, tyro.conf.arg(help="Render chezmoi.toml but skip `chezmoi apply` (for CI / Docker smoke tests)")] = False
706	
707	
708	@dataclass
709	class DoctorCmd:
710	    """Check that .chezmoi.toml.tmpl, Dockerfile, and this script agree on prompt keys."""
711	
712	    source: Annotated[Path, tyro.conf.arg(help="Path to chezmoi source dir")] = CHEZMOI_SOURCE_DIR
713	
714	
715	@dataclass
716	class ListBundlesCmd:
717	    """List available bundles and their overrides."""
718	
719	
720	Command = (
721	    Annotated[InitCmd, tyro.conf.subcommand(name="init")]
722	    | Annotated[DoctorCmd, tyro.conf.subcommand(name="doctor")]
723	    | Annotated[ListBundlesCmd, tyro.conf.subcommand(name="list-bundles")]
724	)
725	
726	
727	def run_init(cmd: InitCmd) -> int:
728	    pf = detect()
729	    print_preflight(pf)
730	
731	    # TTY is only required for interactive mode. --yes / --dry-run don't need one.
732	    if not cmd.yes and not cmd.dry_run and not pf.is_tty:
733	        console.print("[red]No TTY detected — cannot run interactive prompts.\n"
734	                      "If you piped this from curl, re-exec with `</dev/tty`.\n"
735	                      "For non-interactive use, pass --yes (and optionally --bundle / --name / --email / --profile).[/red]")
736	        return 2
737	
738	    # Ensure chezmoi
739	    if pf.chezmoi:
740	        chezmoi_bin = pf.chezmoi
741	    elif cmd.yes:
742	        console.print("[yellow]chezmoi not found; installing silently...[/yellow]")
743	        chezmoi_bin = _install_chezmoi_silent()
744	    else:
745	        chezmoi_bin = install_chezmoi_interactive(pf.os_name)
746	
747	    # Ensure ssh key (only matters for fresh init with --ssh clone)
748	    use_ssh = cmd.ssh or bool(pf.ssh_hint)
749	    if not pf.source_exists and use_ssh and not pf.ssh_hint:
750	        if cmd.yes:
751	            use_ssh = False  # silent HTTPS fallback in non-interactive mode
752	            console.print("[yellow]No SSH key; using HTTPS clone (non-interactive).[/yellow]")
753	        else:
754	            key = ensure_ssh_key_interactive()
755	            if key is None:
756	                use_ssh = False
757	                console.print("[yellow]Falling back to HTTPS clone (no SSH key).[/yellow]")
758	
759	    # Bundle: flag → picker → default "minimal" under --yes (Docker/CI)
760	    if cmd.bundle:
761	        bundle_name = cmd.bundle
762	    elif cmd.yes:
763	        bundle_name = "minimal"
764	    else:
765	        bundle_name = ask_bundle()
766	    if bundle_name not in BUNDLES:
767	        console.print(f"[red]Unknown bundle: {bundle_name}[/red]")
768	        return 2
769	    overrides = dict(BUNDLES[bundle_name])
770	    console.print(f"[dim]Bundle: {bundle_name}[/dim]\n")
771	
772	    # Basics & features — interactive prompts vs pure resolution.
773	    if cmd.yes:
774	        basics = resolve_basics_non_interactive(
775	            pf, overrides,
776	            name_flag=cmd.name, email_flag=cmd.email, profile_flag=cmd.profile,
777	        )
778	        features = resolve_features_non_interactive(pf, overrides)
779	    else:
780	        basics = ask_basics(pf, overrides)
781	        features = ask_features(pf, overrides)
782	
783	    answers: dict[str, object] = {**basics, **features}
784	
785	    argv = build_chezmoi_argv(
786	        answers,
787	        chezmoi_bin=chezmoi_bin,
788	        repo=None if pf.source_exists else cmd.repo,
789	        use_ssh=use_ssh,
790	        apply=not cmd.no_apply,
791	        darwin=(pf.os_name == "darwin"),
792	    )
793	
794	    if not cmd.yes and not confirm_plan(answers, argv):
795	        console.print("[yellow]Aborted.[/yellow]")
796	        return 130
797	
798	    if cmd.dry_run:
799	        console.print(Panel(" ".join(argv), title="dry-run", border_style="yellow"))
800	        return 0
801	
802	    rc = run_chezmoi(argv)
803	    print_recap(answers, rc)
804	    return rc
805	
806	
807	def _install_chezmoi_silent() -> str:
808	    """Non-interactive chezmoi install; same one-liner as install_chezmoi_interactive."""
809	    target = Path.home() / ".local" / "bin"
810	    target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
811	    subprocess.check_call(
812	        "curl -fsLS --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 get.chezmoi.io/lb | sh",
813	        shell=True,
814	        env={**os.environ, "BINDIR": str(target)},
815	    )
816	    return shutil.which("chezmoi") or str(target / "chezmoi")
817	
818	
819	def run_doctor(cmd: DoctorCmd) -> int:
820	    if not cmd.source.exists():
821	        console.print(f"[red]Source dir not found: {cmd.source}[/red]")
822	        return 2
823	    return doctor_report(cmd.source)
824	
825	
826	def run_list_bundles(cmd: ListBundlesCmd) -> int:  # noqa: ARG001
827	    for name, overrides in BUNDLES.items():
828	        t = Table(title=name, show_header=False, box=None, padding=(0, 2))
829	        t.add_column(style="cyan"); t.add_column()
830	        for p in PROMPTS:
831	            if p.hidden or p.kind != "bool":
832	                continue
833	            v = overrides.get(p.key, p.default)
834	            origin = "(bundle)" if p.key in overrides else "(default)"
835	            t.add_row(p.key, f"{v} [dim]{origin}[/dim]")
836	        console.print(t); console.print()
837	    return 0
838	
839	
840	def main() -> int:
841	    cmd = tyro.cli(Command, default=InitCmd())
842	    if isinstance(cmd, InitCmd):
843	        return run_init(cmd)
844	    if isinstance(cmd, DoctorCmd):
845	        return run_doctor(cmd)
846	    if isinstance(cmd, ListBundlesCmd):
847	        return run_list_bundles(cmd)
848	    return 2
849	
850	
851	if __name__ == "__main__":
852	    sys.exit(main())

13	    # when inject_facts_as_vars=False, so we use a dedicated variable instead.

18	      failed_when: false
19	      tags: [always]
